novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: it predicts that evidential marking forms a causally active residual-stream direction and that “a hearsay-marked premise given in Turkish contaminates the certainty/answer produced when the model is queried in English,” with coupling strength determined by grammaticalized evidentiality. The closest work found under searches for “LLM grammatical evidentiality certainty,” “cross-lingual evidentiality language models,” and “multilingual activation steering information source” was Tosun and Filipović’s 2024 bilingual-human study of Turkish evidentiality and confidence, alongside generic cross-lingual representation-steering work such as Cross-Lingual Activation Steering for Multilingual Language Models (2026); neither proposes evidential-source leakage into another language’s reasoning or a causal source-information representation in an LLM. Moving from those works to the claimed grammar-dependent certainty coupling and cross-language leakage requires a new core relationship rather than merely changing the language or renaming standard probing and steering, although the measurement tools themselves are established, supporting high rather than paradigm-level novelty.
